dict.string: Kontinue AI uses the microphone for voice dictation in the chat box, and for apps you build and open in its browser.
Apps you build and open in Kontinue AI's browser can use the camera.
Apps you build and open in Kontinue AI's browser can use your location, for example to show a map.
